verdict.rationale: Numeral publishes a versioned API reference with per-endpoint pages (ping, merchants, platform calculations and transactions, products, refunds, refund reversals). A quickstart walks through concrete POST calls with a TEST API key, so the reference itself is well evidenced. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable code examples within the reference, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
